before.name: Renter-occupied housing units paying 30% or more of household income in gross rent
before.source: Census Reporter API, republishing U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2024 5-year table B25070
before.notes: Captured raw API response identifies release acs2024_5yr (2020–2024), geography 16000US0611250 Carmel-by-the-Sea, and B25070 universe renter-occupied housing units. Table estimates: total 646; not computed 28; 30.0–34.9%=61, 35.0–39.9%=44, 40.0–49.9%=60, 50.0%+=179. Numerator 344 and computable denominator 618 (646−28), so 344/618×100=55.66%, rounded to 55.7%. Prompt says over 30%; ACS bin includes exactly 30.0%, so cannot isolate a strict >30 share from published bins. Census Reporter republishes ACS and is a long-running nonprofit data service (tier 3); official Census API endpoint failed during this pass. Margins of error for the constituent categories are large (30–34.9 ±60, 35–39.9 ±44, 40–49.9 ±59, 50+ ±148); combined-share MOE was not calculated.
before.review_note: Archived screenshot 04546e42323ac53c.png and raw B25070 response establish city ACS 2020–2024 renter-occupied housing units: total 646, not computed 28, qualifying bins 61+44+60+179=344; 344/(646−28)×100=55.6634→55.7, conditional score 85.7. Independent live Neilsberg corroborates 55.7; reviewer API refetch failed. This resolves denominator/exclusions, but the published bins are 30.0% OR MORE and cannot isolate the framework’s strict OVER 30% share. This is a supported related measure with an explicit construct flag, not an exact verified match to the unchanged indicator definition. Constituent MOEs are large; no combined percentage MOE has been calculated. No human disposition/approval implied.

before.name: Renter-occupied units paying 30% or more of income in gross rent
before.source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B25070, Monterey County row; underlying estimates are U.S. Census Bureau ACS
before.notes: Table B25070 covers renter-occupied housing units. Sum of ACS estimate cells at gross rent ≥30% of household income: B25070007 5,888 + B25070008 3,826 + B25070009 8,738 + B25070010 16,798 = 35,250. Exclude B25070011 “Not computed” (1,967) from the denominator: 62,754 total − 1,967 = 60,787 with computed ratios. Share = 35,250 ÷ 60,787 × 100 = 57.989%, rounded to 58.0%; uncertainty was not propagated for the derived share. The framework's strict >30% construct cannot be isolated from the published bins because the first included bin starts at exactly 30.0%; this finding is therefore 30% or more and has a construct-match limitation. Release ACS 2024 1-year; GEOID 05000US06053. County sources did not provide an accessible current value; Census API returned 503 and direct data.census.gov row was inaccessible, so Census Reporter is classified tier 3 and the source access limitation is explicit.
before.review_note: Inspected dd6e71fc936cda74.png and raw B25070: county ACS 2024 one-year renter-occupied universe; total 62,754, not computed 1,967. Numerator 5,888+3,826+8,738+16,798 = 35,250; 35,250/(62,754−1,967)×100 = 57.989% → 58.0%; conditional score 93.3. Bins include exactly 30.0%, so the unchanged framework’s strict OVER 30% share cannot be isolated. The corrected name identifies 30% OR MORE. Keep the construct flag; no combined-share MOE was calculated. Related measurement is supported; exact framework match remains uncertain.
